item.tib: gzhan gyi mi thub pa dang ri rab mchog ma rin po che bzang po'i bsgrub thabs
item.skt: a pa ra tsi ta me du b+ho dang ka ra rad na b+ha la sa d+ha naM
item.coloph: gnod sbyin yid 'phrog gi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon chen po in dra bo d+his mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po kha che paNa chen dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba tshul khrims gzhon nus bsgyur ba'o
